identity_boundary: 한일남 is the Korean-script name printed in Republic of Korea administrative sanctions materials for a source-described 313총국 Changchun IT delegation head. The ROK designation and stated rationale are administrative government actions; no criminal charge, conviction, or finding of guilt is recorded. The sources publish the Korean-script form only; a Latin-script rendering requires an authoritative source. Unrelated South Korean people who share the same Korean name remain separate. Historical delegation and location descriptions cover context; present location and current activity require separate evidence, and financial, address, identity-image, victim, and private selectors are omitted.
